title: FRIDAY NIGHT: Electro Disco Dance BGM (original score)
description:
Friday, 11:58 PM. The laptop snaps shut after a brutal week, the empty metro is all hers, and up on the rooftop her friends are already dancing under string lights. They dance until the sky turns pink.

A feel-good electro nu-disco groove: a fat funky bassline, four-on-the-floor drums, chicken-scratch guitar, clavinet, glittering disco strings and a bright synth hook you'll be humming all weekend. Use it for weekend reels, party edits, travel vlogs, dance videos and good-mood montages. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Friday Night, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
